<Orange>[Match Progression]</>
 1. The Arena is a PvP content where two teams face each other. The match ends when a team <Yellow>reaches the target score</> or the <Yellow>time runs out</>.
 - Each kill grants 1 base point, and <Yellow>wiping the entire opposing team</> grants bonus points.
 - Contributing to a kill increases your <Yellow>Assist</> count, but does not add to the score.
 - If both teams are tied when time runs out, the match ends in a draw.
 2. The entire <Yellow>battlefield is a PvP-enabled area</> with no designated safe zones.
 - Upon death, your character will respawn in a designated area after a waiting period, and gain a brief <Yellow>Invincibility effect</>.
 3. Touch the buff objects that appear at designated locations within the battlefield to gain various combat advantages.
 - Buff effects vary depending on their spawn locations.
 4. Matchmaking is only available during the designated hours on the content's main screen.
 - Matches already in progress will proceed normally even after the scheduled time ends.
 5. If your character was in a combat-enabled area when entering the battlefield, <Yellow>Auto-Combat will be considered active</> for the duration of the match.

<Orange>[Abandonment and Penalties]</>
 1. If you leave a match midway or remain inactive for an extended period, the system treats it as an <Yellow>Abandonment</>.
 2. Abandonment results in a <Yellow>Forced Defeat</>, which heavily reduces your rating score and <Yellow>restricts matching</> for a certain duration.
 - The match officially begins at the moment you <Yellow>accept</>, and all penalties apply from that point onward.
 - Failing to join the match due to slow loading or other technical issues also counts as Abandonment.

<Orange>[Rewards]</>
 1. <Yellow>Arena Badges</> earned from matches can be exchanged for various rewards at the exclusive shop.
 - Base rewards are determined by match outcomes (win, loss, or draw), with bonus resources awarded for <Yellow>MVP</> or the <Yellow>First Win of the Day</>.
 - While a <Yellow>weekly cap</> applies to the resources, you can still play matches and earn or lose rating points.
 2. <Yellow>League Milestone Rewards</> are granted immediately upon reaching a new league tier each season. Furthermore, <Yellow>Season Rewards</> will be awarded based on your final league standings at the end of the season.

<Orange>[Season Rules]</>
 1. The Arena is <Yellow>season-based</>.
 - Your initial league placement is based on your character level upon entering for the first time.
 - You cannot claim season rewards if you fail to place into a league during the season.
 2. When a <Yellow>new season</> begins, the system <Yellow>readjusts your rating score</> based on your records from the previous season.
 3. If you do not play any match for a certain period after league placement, your status changes to <Yellow>Inactive</>, and your <Yellow>rating score will periodically decrease</>.
 - You cannot restore rating scores lost due to inactivity, but playing a match will restore your status to active.

<Orange>[Party Formation Rules]</>
 - You can form a party and queue for matchmaking without any restrictions.
 - You can also participate solo without recruiting any party members.

<Orange>[Matchmaking Rules]</>
 - Anomalous Incursion features a unified matchmaking pool for both solo and party players.
 - Individual participants and parties are matched together in the same battle. Please review your rewards or missions to choose the right queue for you.

<Orange>[Scaled Stats]</>
 - To ensure a fairer combat environment, Anomalous Incursion applies unique stats based on predefined level brackets.
 - Your level and stats will be adjusted depending on the bracket your character's current level falls into.
 - Your level and stats may scale higher or lower than your original values during this process, but these changes apply only within the Anomalous Incursion match.
 - Once the match ends and you return to the Forsaken Land, these scaled stats will be deactivated.

<Orange>[Individual Matchmaking Rewards]</>
 - Even if you participate solo without a party, you can still earn rewards based on your individual survival rank.
 - Reward types and quantities may differ from those of party participants.

<Orange>[Party Matchmaking Rewards]</>
 - If you participate in a party of 2 or more players, you will earn rewards based on your party's final survival rank.
 - You will not receive rewards based on your individual survival rank; rewards are determined by the party's rank at the exact moment all party members are eliminated.
